name: net.url
doc:
URLs (RFC 3986) with Go's net/url semantics: Parse, String, escaping
per component, query Values, ResolveReference with dot-segment removal,
JoinPath. Unlike Go, the host and the port are separate fields (Host
holds no brackets; HostPort() joins them back).

items.name: JoinPath
items.doc: Joins base and elems as a URL path.
items.summary: Joins base and elems as a URL path.

items.name: Parse
items.doc: Parses an absolute or relative URL.
items.summary: Parses an absolute or relative URL.

items.name: ParseQuery
items.doc:
Parses a query string; the first error is returned (Go also rejects
';' separators). URL.Query keeps the well-formed pairs instead.
items.summary: Parses a query string; the first error is returned (Go also rejects ';' separators).

items.name: ParseRequestURI
items.doc: Parses a URL from an HTTP request line (absolute or an absolute path).
items.summary: Parses a URL from an HTTP request line (absolute or an absolute path).

items.name: PathEscape

items.name: PathUnescape

items.summary: PathUnescape decodes a path segment ("+" stays as is).

items.name: QueryEscape

items.name: QueryUnescape

items.summary: QueryUnescape decodes a query component ("+" is a space).
